name: PVR INOX Limited

profile.summary: PVR INOX Limited, a theatrical exhibition company, engages in the exhibition, distribution, and production of movies in India and Sri Lanka. The company is involved in sale of movie tickets; in cinema advertisements/product displays; sale of food and beverages; and restaurant business. It also manages cinema screens; and designing, developing, operating and maintaining food courts and other food outlets. The company was formerly known as PVR Limited and changed its name to PVR INOX Limited in April 2023. PVR INOX Limited was founded in 1991 and is based in Gurugram, India.
